note: Repo is public. #1-#8 combine 13 of these drafts. Roy 2026-11-13: the other 10 small fixes are built in-house, not posted; only Digital-frame mode (a new feature) stays a contributor draft.

issues.title: Replay D1 migrations from empty in CI
issues.body:
Catch a broken migration before it reaches staging.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CI job creates a fresh local D1 and applies every file in `apps/api/migrations`
- [ ] Same job for `apps/site/migrations`
- [ ] Job fails when a migration errors

## Where to look
`apps/api/migrations/`, `apps/site/migrations/`

issues.title: Add a pre-commit hook for typecheck and format
issues.body:
Fast local feedback keeps PRs clean.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Husky or lefthook runs typecheck on staged TypeScript files
- [ ] Hook skipped in CI
- [ ] `.editorconfig` added
- [ ] Documented in CONTRIBUTING.md

## Where to look
repo root

issues.title: Add unit tests for the mobile lib folder
issues.body:
The Expo app has no unit tests; only the API has them.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Test runner added to `apps/mobile` (jest-expo)
- [ ] At least 10 tests for pure functions in `apps/mobile/src/lib`
- [ ] `npm --prefix apps/mobile test` passes in CI

## Where to look
`apps/mobile/src/lib`

issues.title: Per-post share card image for /p/:id
issues.body:
Links pasted into X, iMessage, Slack and Discord should show the work and its maker. The page already has og tags; add a generated card image.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Route returns a 1200x630 image for a post (work, maker handle, verification line in words)
- [ ] `og:image` and `twitter:card=summary_large_image` set on `/p/:id`
- [ ] Cache headers set; unknown post returns 404
- [ ] Test covers the route
- [ ] Checked with a card validator and a Discord paste

## Where to look
`apps/api/src`

issues.title: oEmbed endpoint and embed page for posts
issues.body:
Blogs and newsletters should embed a post, with a link back. Bluesky does this with its `bskyembed` service.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `GET /oembed?url=` returns valid oEmbed JSON for `/p/:id` URLs
- [ ] `/embed/:id` renders a small iframe-safe page
- [ ] `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json+oembed">` on post pages
- [ ] Tests for valid, missing and non-Emera URLs

## Where to look
`apps/api/src`

issues.title: RSS and Atom feeds for creators and the global feed
issues.body:
Readers and automations follow creators with no account.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `/@handle/feed.xml` returns valid Atom with media enclosures
- [ ] `/feed.xml` returns the 50 newest public posts
- [ ] Feed passes an online validator
- [ ] `<link rel="alternate">` on profile pages
- [ ] Tests added

## Where to look
`apps/api/src`

issues.title: Make the web build an installable PWA
issues.body:
The Expo web export should install to the home screen on iOS, Android and desktop.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Web manifest with name, icons (192, 512, maskable), theme and background colors from `packages/brand`
- [ ] Service worker caches the shell and shows an offline page
- [ ] Lighthouse install check passes
- [ ] No new native dependency

## Where to look
`apps/mobile`

issues.title: iPad and Android tablet layout
issues.body:
On wide screens the feed should use two columns and a side panel.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Layout switches at 768 px width
- [ ] Works in portrait and landscape
- [ ] Touch targets stay at least 44pt
- [ ] Screenshots of both sizes attached to the PR

## Where to look
`apps/mobile/src/components`

issues.title: Prototype Android TV and Fire TV build with react-native-tvos
issues.body:
One build should cover Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV. Expo documents TV builds through a config plugin.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Branch builds an APK that launches on an Android TV emulator
- [ ] Feed rows are navigable with a D-pad and show a focus ring
- [ ] Playback of one video post with `expo-video`
- [ ] Notes on what blocked a Fire Stick test, if anything
- [ ] Status in `docs/platforms.md` and `data/platforms.json` updated

## Where to look
`apps/mobile`, https://docs.expo.dev/guides/building-for-tv

issues.title: Prototype Apple TV (tvOS) build
issues.body:
Same TV codebase as Android TV, with the tvOS focus engine.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] App launches in the tvOS simulator
- [ ] Feed rows navigable with the Siri Remote
- [ ] Sign-in by a code shown on screen and entered on a phone (spec only is fine)
- [ ] Findings written up

## Where to look
`apps/mobile`

issues.title: Roku channel prototype (SceneGraph)
issues.body:
Roku needs a native SceneGraph channel, not React Native. Start with a read-only grid of public posts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] New folder `tv/roku` with a sideloadable channel
- [ ] Grid reads a JSON feed from the staging API
- [ ] Playback of one post
- [ ] README with sideload steps
- [ ] List of open questions for Roku certification

## Where to look
`tv/roku` (new)

issues.title: Samsung Tizen and LG webOS TV web app shell
issues.body:
Both TV platforms run packaged web apps. Build one TV-friendly web layout and package it twice.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Spatial navigation (arrow keys and Enter) on the feed
- [ ] Layout readable at 10 feet (type at least 28 px)
- [ ] Packaged builds for Tizen Studio and webOS Studio, or a written reason if a store account blocks it

## Where to look
`tv/web` (new)

issues.title: Browser extension: report a copy of this page
issues.body:
Creators find copies on other sites. An extension puts the report flow there.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Manifest V3 extension for Chrome and Firefox
- [ ] Toolbar button opens the report form prefilled with the page URL
- [ ] Screenshot of the visible tab attached with consent
- [ ] No data leaves the browser until the creator presses send

## Where to look
`extensions/` (new)

issues.title: Cross-post to Bluesky as a companion post
issues.body:
Posts should optionally appear in Bluesky with a link back. Needs a design note first.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Short design note on how the `social.emera.post` and `app.bsky.feed.post` records stay in sync
- [ ] Opt-in per creator in settings
- [ ] Unit tests with a fake PDS
- [ ] Deleting in Emera deletes the companion

## Where to look
`lexicons/`, `apps/api/src`

issues.title: Feed generator for Emera creators
issues.body:
A custom feed that Bluesky users can pin. Start from the Bluesky feed-generator starter kit.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Feed generator service answers `getFeedSkeleton`
- [ ] Serves the 100 newest Emera posts
- [ ] Deploy notes for a Worker or a small Node host
- [ ] README with how to publish the feed record

## Where to look
`services/feedgen` (new), https://github.com/bluesky-social/feed-generator

issues.title: Golden test files for social.emera lexicons
issues.body:
Lexicon changes should never silently break records.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Valid and invalid example records for post, profile and provenance
- [ ] Test runs them through the validator in `spikes/provenance`
- [ ] Runs in CI

## Where to look
`lexicons/`, `spikes/provenance`

issues.title: Translation setup with Lingui
issues.body:
Extract every user-facing string so people can translate Emera.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Lingui configured in `apps/mobile`
- [ ] All strings in `apps/mobile/src` wrapped
- [ ] English source catalog committed
- [ ] `docs/localization.md` explains how to add a language
- [ ] CI fails when the catalog is out of date

## Where to look
`apps/mobile`

issues.title: Translate the app into your language
issues.body:
Opens once the catalog exists. One issue per language.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Complete catalog for one language
- [ ] A native speaker proof-reads it
- [ ] Right-to-left check if the language needs it

## Where to look
`apps/mobile/src/locales`

issues.title: Screen reader pass on every screen
issues.body:
Verification state must be said in words, never by color alone.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] VoiceOver and TalkBack walk-through notes for every screen
- [ ] Every image has an alt-text field or label
- [ ] Fixes made in the PR or filed as separate issues
- [ ] Touch targets at least 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android

## Where to look
`apps/mobile/src`

issues.title: Respect Reduce Motion and font scaling
issues.body:
Animations must stop and text must grow with system settings.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Reduce Motion disables transitions and autoplay loops
- [ ] Text scales to the largest setting without clipping on the feed and profile screens
- [ ] Screenshots at 100% and 200%

## Where to look
`apps/mobile/src/components`

issues.title: Docker image for the API
issues.body:
Let people run the API outside Cloudflare, or at least test it in a container.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dockerfile builds and starts the API with workerd or a Node adapter
- [ ] Compose file with local storage
- [ ] Documented limits

## Where to look
`apps/api`

issues.title: Public cost page spec and first version
issues.body:
The mission promises a live page of what Emera costs this month.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Spec in `docs/`
- [ ] Static page reading a JSON file of monthly costs
- [ ] Source of each line named

## Where to look
`apps/site`

issues.title: Fresh-machine test of CONTRIBUTING.md
issues.body:
The quickstart must work on a clean computer.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Follow CONTRIBUTING.md on macOS, Linux or Windows (WSL) and record every error
- [ ] Fix the doc or file issues
- [ ] State the OS and Node version tested

## Where to look
`CONTRIBUTING.md`

issues.title: Digital-frame mode for smart displays and spare tablets
issues.body:
A fullscreen slideshow of one creator's work for an Echo Show, Nest Hub or spare tablet.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Route `/@handle/frame` cycles posts every 10 seconds
- [ ] Hides all controls and shows the maker line
- [ ] Works in a TV browser with arrow keys

## Where to look
`apps/api/src`
